_README: Fixed viewpoints for the analogue photoreal view (tools/photoreal_mockup.py, tools/blender_photoreal.py): the same cameras in the browser and in Blender, so renders can be compared with each other and with the reference photos. E, N in EPSG:2326; bearing in degrees clockwise from grid north; eye_m above the ground (or above the roof for 'on_roof'); y_mPD a fixed camera height instead; hfov in degrees. 'compare' names the reference image the view is read against (tools/photoreal_shoot.py pairs it; none for the places added 2026-10-25). The view dropdown lists the views by 'group', in the order of 'groups', and leaves out those marked "list": false (cameras kept for the self-check renders and Blender only). 'start' is the view the page opens on. Reorganised 2026-10-25 at the author's request (places of interest, cut views that showed one wall or nothing); the shots are in work/viewer_1982/view_list/.
